text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (35.0% vs 6.3% expected, score 16.53, z 5.45, 6% low-complexity 99215, 24 documented, 4 documented 99215 with 0 below, 1 of 20 data-no-lab, 14% peer rate). The 4-of-4 supported sample is very thin for that claim.","problems":["Unverifiable numbers: '24 of 30 were usable and the other 6 never arrived' and 'first response had unsigned notes' are not in the evidence card (30 flagged by the script).","'data-without-tests was low (4%)' does not match the card's 1 of 20 (5%); the 4% figure is unsupported.","'the 99215 rate on patients with 0 to 2 conditions is 4 to 5 times the peer rate' is a derived claim; the card rows show 0.101-0.199 vs 0.022-0.053, about 3.8-4.6x, so it is roughly right but loosely stated.","'The charts do not support upcoding' is too strong given only 4 documented 99215 claims, and it conflicts with the headline claiming 'support billing' and the inconclusive leaning.","The only below-billed example (C0103599, 99214) is not a 99215 claim and is weak evidence; the two cited low-complexity 99215 claims (C0103322, C0103348) have no documentation, so the cited claims do not illustrate the documentation finding.","Next steps are generic: no specific claim IDs for the records request, and they do not name the 24 low-complexity 99215 claims as the target of the request.","The summary does not note that the 4 documented 99215 claims are all high-MDM, and it does not flag that the sample was random so it may not cover the low-complexity 99215 claims."]}
